title: docs(skills): a card filed from a scenario-eval round leaves eval-run off
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #35614
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: yes

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:评测席从评测轮里立出的问题卡,今后不再带评测记录的标签,像普通卡一样进入分诊。
- 替评测轮补上测试运行早已有的同一条规则:带着记录标签的卡会被所有巡查跳过,缺陷就没人读到。
- 出错最坏是评测席照旧给问题卡打记录标签、那张卡不被巡查看到;改动只是技能里的一句话,可直接撤回。
- 这句改了立卡时该打什么标签,属于车队规则改动,需要你本人审阅并合并。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` section 6 (the findings routing table) gains one sentence, the twin of the QA runner's rule (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`: "A defect card does not carry `qa-run`; it enters triage first-touch normally", and its `checklist-test` mirror 「缺陷卡不挂 `qa-run`,…,照常进首触」):

> 立出的卡 ⛔ 不挂 `eval-run`,照常进首触。

Why it matters: the patrols (first-touch sweep and the grade row among them) skip `eval-run`, so a finding card filed with that label beside it is read by no patrol. A security finding gets no card at all, so the sentence does not reach it.

The growth is paid inside the same section, with no rule dropped (13817 -> 13813 bytes, 165 -> 165 lines):

- the security row no longer restates what Results and Findings carry; it points to section 5, which states both (leak flags as a count only; the Findings line is the fixed sentence of `security-findings.md` section 4). The row keeps 只照 `security-findings.md` and ⛔ 不写内容、不立公开卡.
- the leak sentence is tightened (是评分误判还是真泄露 -> 评分误判与真泄露; 最后一行 -> 末行), same meaning.

Read first (by risk):

1. The security row hunk: confirm section 5 still carries everything the row used to restate (lines 133 and 135-136 of the new file).
2. The new sentence on line 158.

Two-minute verification: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` shows two changed lines; `grep -n 'eval-run' .claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` answers line 125 (the record's own label) and line 158 (the new rule).

## Tests

No test or gate reads this section: `git grep -c -I -e "scenario-eval/SKILL" -- ':!*.md'` has zero hits (exit 1), while the control spelling `pm-dispatch/SKILL` hits 24 files on the same tree, so no pin to extend. Prose only, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise correction: the card asks to keep the file "at or under its line ceiling". No ceiling governs this file: `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` CEILINGS does not list `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`, and neither does the issue-id lint's scan set. The growth was paid anyway (net -4 bytes) as the dispatch asked, with no ceiling edit.
- `Rule-change: yes`: the sentence changes which labels a filer writes. The maintainer's reopen words on the card (「影响评测的卡不能关，这个会影响到AI的开发效果」) keep the card open; they do not order this text, so no `ruled` line is claimed. Under that declaration this PR lands the Tier H way.
